verdict.rationale: A state business-filing service could plausibly offer API access with scoped credentials, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only a single OHID sign-in account for human users and Filing Administrator portal functions, with no mention of APIs, tokens, or least-privilege credentials for agents. Both the Secretary of State site and the Ohio Business Central filing portal return 403 on robots.txt, so nothing there could be checked for an agent credential surface.
